name: Brunswick County, NC
findings: Brunswick County has 316 nonprofit organizations. 147 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 118 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Brunswick County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Brunswick County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 175 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Brunswick County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 90 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few education organizations list membership
observations.text: 4 education organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 11 would.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through education groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 21 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.
